text:
eval-bot: Nightly eval finished: promptset rollout applied (candidate pset v12) against redwood-q4-int8 canary.

eval-bot: Summary: pset 'entity-dates' F1 dropped from 0.88 -> 0.81 (-0.07). Hallucination count +120% on date-normalization cases. Full diff: /evals/1901234567/report.html

anya: saw this spike in pager earlier, thanks for the heads up. sample bad gen below.

sam: can you paste failing examples? we need to decide revert vs rebaseline.

anya: example 1:
```
input: "When is the deadline?"
expected: "2025-03-01"
candidate: "March 1st 2026"
```
candidate is shifted by a year and adds freeform text.

kevin: looks like quantization jitter on the model's date anchor tokens. this started only for redwood-q4-int8 in canary, fp16 baseline didn't show this magnitude.

rachel: confirm setup: baseline was redwood-fp16 + pset v11, candidate is redwood-q4-int8 + pset v12? if so we should separate pset vs quant effects.

sam: run two isolations: new pset with old model, and new model with old pset. commands I usually run:
```
# new pset, old model
python tools/eval.py --pset v12 --model redwood-fp16 --subset entity-dates
# old pset, new model
python tools/eval.py --pset v11 --model redwood-q4-int8 --subset entity-dates
```

anya: ran both quickly. results: v12+fp16 F1=0.87 (minor drop vs 0.88). v11+q4-int8 F1=0.82. so quantization is the larger contributor, but v12 amplifies sensitivity on a few templates.

kevin: thanks — that suggests we should NOT rebaseline pset v12 right now. proposed plan: rollback pset v12 from canary, hold the promptset change, and run a focused quantization matrix (per-channel symmetric/asymmetric, change calibration set) to find stable config.

rachel: ok agree. rachel to open rollback PR and mark pset v12 as HOLD for rebaseline until quant results. also add the failing templates to the pset issue.

infra-bot: PR created #3751 revert promptset v12 in canary. Assigned: rachel. ETA deploy: ~30m.

sam: also let's add a guard in the release checklist: if any quantized variant shows >5% F1 regression on a pset, block autopromote and require manual sign-off.

anya: noted, filing follow-up doc and checklist entry (link when ready).

kevin: I'll kick off the quantization grid (per-channel symmetric, per-tensor, different calibration priors) and attach results here. ETA ~2h.

eval-bot: follow-up artifact will be posted to /evals/1901234567/followup.json when quant runs finish.

sam: thanks all — good catch. once rollback is live let's rerun nightly to validate stability before reattempting pset v12.
